tagline: Engineers reading engineers care about the chooser, not just the choices. Here is how I evaluate the tech behind this very portfolio.

points.title: Vite + React + TypeScript
points.description: Sub-second HMR, type discipline catches integration bugs at edit-time not at 2am in production. The boring, fast choice.

points.title: Tailwind CSS + Radix UI primitives
points.description: Composable utility CSS + accessible primitives — no bespoke design system bloat. Only the patterns that actually get reused ship.

points.title: JSON data layer, no CMS
points.description: The whole portfolio is content-as-data in versioned JSON files. Diffs of "I changed my title" are real PRs, no async cache to invalidate.

points.title: Static deploy on GitHub Pages
points.description: No server to patch, no env vars to leak, no scaling surprises. Every byte is in version control, every push is a full deploy.
